title: Miamegg (Jamesport Creek)
summary: Miamegg is a Jamesport creek placename connected with a 1648 deed and interpreted as a meeting fishing-place.
introduction_content: Miamegg names a creek near Jamesport in Riverhead town. Related forms include Miamogue, Miomog, and Wyamaug, with later sources sometimes shifting the name from the creek to the nearby point.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as a meeting fishing-place, a locality where people came together to fish, probably for alewives or menhaden used for food and planting.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names tell the story of who we are and where we’ve come from.”

— Jeremy Miles, New priorities to help protect Welsh place names (2025), Ministerial statement
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: The pin is placed near Jamesport and Peconic Bay to represent the creek named in relation to Assasquage. It is offset from Assasquage for map visibility and is not an exact surveyed creek point.
